title: Chiropractic Google Ads: How to Grow Your Practice With Paid Search

facts.fact: The author states that building organic search rankings for competitive local keywords can take six months to a year or more.
facts.value: six months to a year or more
facts.quote: Building organic rankings for competitive local keywords can take six months to a year or more.

facts.fact: The author recommends setting a chiropractic Google Ads campaign's geographic targeting to a radius of usually 10-15 miles around the office, depending on market density.
facts.quote: Set your campaign's geographic targeting to a realistic radius around your office, usually 10-15 miles depending on your market density.

facts.fact: The author states that ad copy has roughly three seconds to convince a searcher to click.
facts.quote: Your ad copy has roughly three seconds to convince someone to click.

facts.fact: The author recommends reviewing the search terms report weekly during the first month of a campaign.
facts.quote: review your search terms report weekly for the first month.

facts.fact: The author lists common negative keywords to add right away to a chiropractic Google Ads campaign: free, jobs, salary, school, degree, certification, insurance (if you don't accept it), and DIY.
facts.quote: Common negatives to add right away include: free, jobs, salary, school, degree, certification, insurance (if you don't accept it), and DIY.

facts.fact: The article is dated September 28, 2026, by author Dr. Jeff Langmaid.
